---
format:
  typst: default
---

```{=typst}
#let navy = rgb("#1E2B55")
#let charcoal = rgb("#20262D")
#let slate = rgb("#596673")
#let mist = rgb("#D9DEE2")
#let sail = rgb("#F4F5F6")
#let pcss-gold = rgb("#F4C91D")
#let level-plus = rgb("#FFF4BF")
#let level-4 = rgb("#D5D9DC")
#let level-3 = rgb("#E2E5E7")
#let level-2 = rgb("#ECEEEF")
#let level-1 = rgb("#F5F6F7")

#set page(
  paper: "us-letter",
  flipped: true,
  margin: (top: 0.32in, bottom: 0.50in, x: 0.52in),
  footer: context [
    #set text(
      font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
      size: 6.8pt,
      fill: slate,
      hyphenate: false,
    )
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 12pt,
      [Open sourced by Andrew Andrade · #link("https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/")[#text(fill: navy)[CC BY 4.0]] means you may share and adapt with attribution · #link("https://github.com/mrandrewandrade/assets")[#text(fill: navy)[github.com/mrandrewandrade/assets]]],
      [Page #counter(page).display("1 of 1", both: true)]
    )
  ]
)

#set text(
  font: ("Arial", "Liberation Sans", "DejaVu Sans"),
  size: 10.4pt,
  fill: charcoal,
  hyphenate: false,
)
#set par(leading: 0.54em, justify: false)

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 2.65in),
  column-gutter: 24pt,
  align: top,
  [
    #text(size: 26pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[About Me Presentation]
    #v(1pt)
    #text(size: 11.5pt, fill: slate)[Help the crew get to know you and find something we can connect with.]
  ],
  [
    #grid(
      columns: (0.58in, 1fr),
      column-gutter: 9pt,
      align: horizon,
      [#image("technology-department-emblem.svg", width: 0.54in)],
      [
        #text(size: 8.3pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Technology Commons]
        #linebreak()
        #text(size: 7.7pt, fill: slate)[Port Credit Secondary School]
      ],
    )
  ],
)

#v(7pt)
#line(length: 0.62in, stroke: 3pt + pcss-gold)
#v(3pt)
#line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.4pt + navy)
#v(8pt)

#grid(
  columns: (0.80fr, 1.32fr, 2.18fr),
  column-gutter: 18pt,
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Length:] about 1-3 minutes],
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Due:] Tues., Sept. 15, 2026 at 7:00 PM],
  [#text(weight: "bold")[Presentations:] Weds., Sept. 16 & Thurs., Sept. 17, 2026],
)
#v(5pt)
#line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.7pt + mist)

#v(8pt)
#text(size: 15.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Learning goal]
#v(3pt)
I can introduce myself clearly, choose details that help others get to know me, and make a meaningful connection with my audience.

#v(6pt)
#block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: sail,
  stroke: (left: 4pt + pcss-gold),
  inset: (left: 14pt, right: 12pt, top: 7pt, bottom: 7pt),
)[
  #text(size: 12pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Help us get to know you. Help us connect with you.]
]
#v(4pt)
You can keep it simple. There is no required number of slides, pictures, or facts.

#v(8pt)
#grid(
  columns: (1.08fr, 0.92fr),
  column-gutter: 26pt,
  [
    #text(size: 15.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[What could you share?]
    #v(3pt)
    Choose whatever helps us understand you. Some ideas:
    #v(2pt)
    - skills or things you are good at
    - hobbies and interests
    - past projects or things you have made, fixed, designed, or worked on
    - a fun or interesting fact
    - future goals
    - something you are looking forward to learning, making, fixing, or trying in this class
    #v(3pt)
    You do #text(weight: "bold")[not] need to include everything on this list.
  ],
  [
    #block(
      stroke: (left: 1.4pt + mist),
      inset: (left: 16pt),
    )[
      #text(size: 15.5pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Keep it accessible]
      #v(3pt)
      If you use slides, everyone in the room should be able to understand them.
      #v(2pt)
      - use large, readable text
      - use clear contrast
      - keep layouts simple
      - use images when they help explain something
      - avoid too much text
      - do not rely on colour alone to communicate meaning
      #v(3pt)
      #text(weight: "bold")[Fancy slides are not the goal. Clear, accessible communication is.]
    ]
  ],
)

#v(6pt)
Submit your presentation through #text(weight: "bold")[Google Classroom] by #text(weight: "bold")[Tues., Sept. 15, 2026 at 7:00 PM].
#v(4pt)
#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[After you present:] We will pause for questions, comments, and connections. Be ready to respond and help the class build a short discussion.

#pagebreak()

#grid(
  columns: (1fr, auto),
  align: horizon,
  [#text(size: 18pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Rubric · /10]],
  [#text(size: 7.7pt, fill: slate)[Technology Commons · Port Credit Secondary School]],
)
#v(3pt)
#text(size: 8.5pt, fill: slate)[Each criterion is worth #text(weight: "bold")[2 marks], for a total of /10: 4+ = 2 · Level 4 = 1.5 · Level 3 = 1 · Level 2 = 0.5 · Level 1 = 0.]
#v(6pt)

#set text(hyphenate: false)
#set par(justify: false)

#table(
  columns: (1.14fr, 1.20fr, 1.30fr, 1.30fr, 1.22fr, 1.16fr),
  inset: (x: 5.5pt, y: 5.7pt),
  align: left + top,
  stroke: 0.5pt + white,
  fill: (x, y) => {
    if x == 1 { level-plus }
    else if x == 2 { level-4 }
    else if x == 3 { level-3 }
    else if x == 4 { level-2 }
    else if x == 5 { level-1 }
    else { white }
  },
  table.header(
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Criterion]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[4+ · 2]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Level 4 · 1.5]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Level 3 · 1]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Level 2 · 0.5]],
    [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Level 1 · 0]],
  ),

  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Knowledge] #linebreak() #text(fill: slate)[What did we learn about you?]],
  [Especially meaningful, specific, or memorable information helps us understand you.],
  [Clear, relevant, specific information helps us understand who you are.],
  [Relevant information gives us a good sense of who you are.],
  [Some relevant information is shared, but ideas may be limited or unclear.],
  [Very limited information is shared.],

  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Thinking] #linebreak() #text(fill: slate)[How did you choose and organize what to share?]],
  [Choices are especially thoughtful, purposeful, or creative.],
  [Ideas are thoughtfully chosen and organized to support the presentation.],
  [Ideas are chosen and organized appropriately.],
  [Some planning is shown, but ideas may be incomplete or disconnected.],
  [Limited planning or organization is evident.],

  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Communication] #linebreak() #text(fill: slate)[Could everyone understand and follow you?]],
  [Exceptionally clear, confident, polished, and easy to follow.],
  [Clear, effective, confident, and easy to follow.],
  [Clear and understandable with only minor lapses.],
  [Usually understandable, but some parts may be difficult to hear or follow.],
  [Often difficult to hear, understand, or follow.],

  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Visuals & accessibility] #linebreak() #text(fill: slate)[Did your supports help the audience?]],
  [Supports are especially purposeful, readable, accessible, and effective.],
  [Supports are highly readable, accessible, purposeful, and effective.],
  [Supporting material is readable, accessible, and useful.],
  [Some choices reduce readability, accessibility, or usefulness.],
  [Supporting material is difficult to read or does not support the presentation.],

  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Application] #linebreak() #text(fill: slate)[Did you connect and discuss?]],
  [Creates a particularly strong connection and responds thoughtfully to questions or comments, extending the discussion.],
  [Effectively introduces yourself, creates a meaningful connection, and responds clearly to questions or comments.],
  [Successfully introduces yourself, makes an appropriate connection, and responds appropriately during discussion.],
  [Some connection is made; responses may be brief or need prompting.],
  [Limited connection is made and there is little response to the discussion.],
)

#v(6pt)
#block(
  width: 100%,
  fill: sail,
  stroke: (left: 3pt + pcss-gold),
  inset: (left: 10pt, right: 10pt, top: 5pt, bottom: 5pt),
)[
  #text(size: 10.2pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Learning Skills · feedback only]
  #v(2pt)
  #text(size: 8.1pt, fill: slate)[These are separate from the /10 mark. Here are examples of how you can show them during this assignment:]
  #v(3pt)
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr),
    column-gutter: 12pt,
    row-gutter: 3pt,
    [#text(size: 8.1pt, weight: "bold")[Responsibility:] #text(size: 8.1pt)[prepared and ready to present]],
    [#text(size: 8.1pt, weight: "bold")[Organization:] #text(size: 8.1pt)[plans and keeps ideas easy to follow]],
    [#text(size: 8.1pt, weight: "bold")[Independent Work:] #text(size: 8.1pt)[uses class time and works without constant prompting]],
    [#text(size: 8.1pt, weight: "bold")[Collaboration:] #text(size: 8.1pt)[listens respectfully, takes notes, and supports discussion]],
    [#text(size: 8.1pt, weight: "bold")[Initiative:] #text(size: 8.1pt)[volunteers to present or contributes a question or connection]],
    [#text(size: 8.1pt, weight: "bold")[Self-Regulation:] #text(size: 8.1pt)[manages time, nerves, focus, and feedback]],
  )
]

#v(5pt)
#grid(
  columns: (1fr, 1.45in),
  column-gutter: 14pt,
  [
    #text(size: 10.4pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Going above and beyond]
    #v(2pt)
    #text(size: 8.4pt)[A 4+ might come from a memorable story, a thoughtful connection, an effective project or object, a strong visual, a creative example, or another choice that genuinely helps the audience understand and connect with you. These are ideas, not extra requirements.]
  ],
  [
    #block(
      width: 100%,
      fill: navy,
      inset: (x: 10pt, y: 10pt),
    )[
      #align(center)[
        #text(size: 8.5pt, fill: white)[TOTAL]
        #linebreak()
        #text(size: 20pt, weight: "bold", fill: white)[/10]
      ]
    ]
  ],
)
```
